strength_transform: Raise the v11 normalized, bounded attack/defence strengths to the chosen power; retain venue baselines and all player components
attacker_calibration: For MID/FWD only, raw_points*slope + expected_appearance_count*offset. Fit residuals toward identity with L2 penalty 100 on RMS-scaled raw-points and appearance-count features; floor final GW score at zero. GK/DEF retain identity calibration.
candidate_pool: Fixed union of heuristic-v1 and original decision-v11 top 40, using pre-deadline features alone
selection_objective: Lowest mean weekly candidate RMSE on 2023/24; Poisson deviance breaks ties; retain strength power closest to the original value 1 on exact ties
evaluation: Paired whole-GW bootstrap, 5000 draws, seed 1729; 2024/25 is an inspected diagnostic, not a new holdout
rollout: Separate prospective model and experiment identity; keep heuristic-v1 live and decision-v11 as a frozen comparison. Existing promotion thresholds remain unchanged.
